description: Publishes governed national through ZIP coverage views and explicit gaps from immutable registry and geography dependencies.
retry: Rerun from immutable dependency pointers; a completed dependency release is never modified.
checkpoint: Output remains in run-scoped staging until every view and manifest check passes.
idempotency: View IDs and row semantics are deterministic for the same immutable dependency releases; release IDs identify publication runs.
cancellation: Stop after the current profile partition; staged artifacts remain unpublished.
source_policy: config/source-policies/national-business-coverage-views.json; Alaska-derived source and ZIP aggregates retain local-aggregate-review-required semantics, Washington L&I-derived aggregates require PDDL attribution and retained semantic limitations, DC-derived aggregates require CC BY 4.0 attribution and retained semantic limitations, California ABC-derived aggregates require publisher attribution plus retained license-scope and privacy limitations, and New York retail-food-derived aggregates require OPEN-NY attribution plus retained snapshot and geocode limitations.
retention_profile: Retain immutable aggregate releases with their exact dependency hashes until explicitly approved removal; Alaska-derived aggregates require terms review, Washington L&I-derived aggregates require PDDL attribution plus semantic limitations, DC-derived aggregates require CC BY 4.0 attribution plus semantic limitations, California ABC-derived aggregates require source attribution plus license-scope and privacy limitations, and New York retail-food-derived aggregates require OPEN-NY attribution plus source limitations before redistribution.
